context_for_next_testing_agent: Authentication system fully tested and working. Backend endpoints: /api/auth/register, /api/auth/login, /api/users/me. JWT tokens stored in localStorage as 'auth_token'. Token expiry is 24 hours. All admin routes protected, public storefront (/store/:storeId) is not protected. Minor issue: Error messages in preview environment show generic 'Network error' due to Emergent debug monitor consuming response bodies - this is environment-specific and won't affect production.

api_endpoints_tested.POST /api/auth/register: Working - creates user and returns JWT token
api_endpoints_tested.POST /api/auth/login: Working - authenticates user and returns JWT token
api_endpoints_tested.GET /api/users/me: Working - returns user profile with valid token

notes: The authentication system is fully functional. The error message display issue is specific to the Emergent preview environment where a debug monitor script intercepts and consumes fetch response bodies. This causes 'response.json()' to fail with 'body stream already read' error, falling back to the generic 'Network error' message. In production deployment without the debug monitor, the actual API error messages (e.g., 'Invalid email or password') will be displayed correctly.
